svg.text: Congregation bus · Brother Amos Teel — contestant vehicle dossier
“He counted forty souls onto that bus. The river was always going to have them.”
Roof bell + a cross of guardrail steel
Forty seats. Forty hymnals. All empty.
A short rusty county church bus, faded hand-
painted scripture, windows fogged from the inside
with faint handprints, a rooftop bell and a
lower body, ominous, realistic game-ready PBR
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
